Treasurer Office
Kearney County
Nebraska
Jody Payne
Contact
308-832-2730
308-832-2731 – Fax
treasurer@kearneycountyne.gov
treasurer.staff@kearneycountyne.gov
Office Hours
8:30 a.m. – 5:00 p.m.
Monday – Friday
Open through the lunch hour
Closed Weekends and Holidays
Mailing Address
PO Box 299
Minden, NE 68959
Location
424 N Colorado
Minden, NE 68959
Treasurer Office
Duties
To collect all revenues for the County
To bill and collect all real estate and personal taxes in the County
Register all motor vehicles with tax situs in the County
To collect payment for driver licenses, C.D.L.’s, learner permits, I.D. cards, school permits, etc. issued by the DMV.
To disburse collections to the proper political subdivisions
Boat Registration
Snowmobile Registration
DMV Services is a Department of the State of Nebraska that is operated by the Treasurer Office.
